import datetime
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)
c.setFillColorRGB(0.10, 0.20, 0.45)
c.rect(0, height - 14, width, 14, stroke=0, fill=1)

c.setLineWidth(2)
c.line(width * 0.25, height * 0.53, width * 0.75, height * 0.53)

c.setFont('Helvetica', 16)
dw = c.stringWidth(date_str, 'Helvetica', 16)
c.drawString((width - dw) / 2, height * 0.48, date_str)
c.setFillColorRGB(0.10, 0.20, 0.45)
c.rect(0, 0, width, 14, stroke=0, fill=1)
c.save()
print('cover created')

cov = PdfReader(COVER)
